title: Progress contract: per-file percent, aggregate percent, and a polite live-region tick
description: Every file in the upload set carries a per-file percent that advances monotonically from 0 to 100. The surface also carries an aggregate percent that reflects the mean weighted by byte size. A polite live-region wrapper (aria-live polite) receives a text tick per the elicited announcement cap (default 2 seconds, owned by `TAC-2403.interfaces.announcementInterval`) with the string format "<uploaded> of <total> files, <PP> percent". Internal progress polling runs at the internal cadence owned by `TAC-2403.interfaces.tickInterval` (default 250 ms, internal only, not user-observable); the polite wrapper is preseeded at render time so a screen reader adopts it before the first announcement fires.
rationale: Per visual round 4 spec section 5.2, REQ 2.
